# AEAN Studios

> AEAN Studios is a design studio in Wigan, Greater Manchester, run by Emma Winnard. It designs websites and social media for small businesses, and book covers and YouTube thumbnails for independent authors and creators, alongside logos, brand identity and brand photography. Clients are mainly in the North West of England and across the UK.

## For small businesses

- [Website Design](https://aeanstudios.com/websites): Custom websites for small businesses, set up for search engines (SEO) and AI answer engines (AEO). From £200 for a single-page site; the price covers design and build only, with domain, hosting and paid third-party tools separate.
- [Social Media Management](https://aeanstudios.com/social-media): Planning, designing and posting from £120 a month, with filming days and full week-to-week management quoted on top.
- [Logos and Brand Identity](https://aeanstudios.com/logos): Logos from £50 and brand identities from £100.
- [Brand Photography](https://aeanstudios.com/photography): Half-day and full-day shoots around Wigan for spaces, products and social content.

## For authors and creators

- [Book Cover Design](https://aeanstudios.com/book-covers): Cover art and typography for independent authors. Ebook covers from £100, with paperback wraps and print files priced on top.
- [YouTube Thumbnails](https://aeanstudios.com/thumbnails): Custom thumbnails from £50.

## About

- [About](https://aeanstudios.com/about): Who runs the studio and how a project runs.
- [Selected Work](https://aeanstudios.com/work): Book covers, brand identities and campaign design.
- [Studio Notes](https://aeanstudios.com/notes): Articles on websites, social media and marketing for small businesses.
- [Design and AI](https://aeanstudios.com/ai): All client design work is original; where AI is used in running the studio.
- [Plan builder](https://aeanstudios.com/plan): Describe a business in plain words and get a tailored plan of which services would help, in order, with starting prices.
- [Start a project](https://aeanstudios.com/contact): Project brief with price estimates, plus frequently asked questions.
